breakdown.description: Hydrostatic formula assumes only gravitational acceleration
breakdown.reason: The generated specification repeats the original flawed hydrostatic formula P = rho*g*h verbatim and does not replace it with the correct rotating fluid equilibrium equation dP/dr = rho*r*omega^2. While the last line vaguely mentions a 'modified formula,' it does not specify the correct equation and contradicts itself by also including standard gravitational acceleration as a parameter.

breakdown.description: Centrifugal acceleration dominates gravitational acceleration in a centrifuge
breakdown.reason: Although the last line mentions using 'centrifugal acceleration instead of gravitational acceleration,' the specification still includes 'Use standard gravitational acceleration of 9.81 m/s²' and frames the problem in terms of fluid column height rather than radial distance and angular velocity. The ground truth requires the radial pressure distribution (dP/dr = rho*r*omega^2), which the specification fails to properly establish.
